name: funraise
description: FUNRAISE MCP connects ChatGPT to Taiwan's official real-estate and company records. Ask in plain language about transaction prices, office buildings, land parcels, urban renewal zones, building permits, industrial parks and company registration, and get answers grounded in government records rather than recollection. Coverage: Ministry of the Interior actual price registration for sales, rentals and pre-sales (2012 onwards); cadastral maps covering 19 of Taiwan's 22 counties and cities; nationwide urban renewal areas and development zones; Taipei building and use permits with scanned drawings; the Ministry of Economic Affairs company and business registries; and all 212 industrial parks. Every tool is read-only and answers state their own limits. When a county or district is not covered, the tool says so instead of returning an empty result.

defaultPrompt: 台北市信義區今年的辦公室成交行情如何？
內湖科技園區裡有哪些上市櫃公司？
大安區有哪些都市更新案？範圍多大？
interface.displayName: 方睿科技 FUNRAISE TW REAL ESTATE
interface.longDescription: FUNRAISE MCP connects ChatGPT to Taiwan's official real-estate and company records. Ask in plain language about transaction prices, office buildings, land parcels, urban renewal zones, building permits, industrial parks and company registration, and get answers grounded in government records rather than recollection. Coverage: Ministry of the Interior actual price registration for sales, rentals and pre-sales (2012 onwards); cadastral maps covering 19 of Taiwan's 22 counties and cities; nationwide urban renewal areas and development zones; Taipei building and use permits with scanned drawings; the Ministry of Economic Affairs company and business registries; and all 212 industrial parks. Every tool is read-only and answers state their own limits. When a county or district is not covered, the tool says so instead of returning an empty result.

positive.description: Office transaction prices in a Taipei district. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 台北市信義區今年的辦公室成交行情如何？ — English: 'How is the office transaction market in Xinyi District, Taipei this year?' The model should filter by main_use=辦公用 (office use), not building type.
positive.prompt: 台北市信義區今年的辦公室成交行情如何？
positive.expected_behavior: Calls actual-price-sale__search_actual_sales with city=台北市, district=信義區, main_use=辦公用 and a since date of this year. Answers with the number of office transactions found (28 between 2026-01-01 and 2026-11-07 when this case was written) and sample deals with address, date, total price and unit price, and states the filters used. No fabricated numbers.

positive.description: Company registry lookup. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 台積電的統一編號和登記地址是什麼？ — English: 'What is TSMC's unified business number and registered address?'
positive.prompt: 台積電的統一編號和登記地址是什麼？
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 台灣積體電路製造股份有限公司 with unified business number 22099131, registered address 新竹市東區科園里科學園區力行六路8號, organization type 股份有限公司 and registered capital (NT$259,323,700,670).

positive.description: Land parcel lookup by section and parcel number. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 新竹市三姓段 69-1 地號的面積有多大？在哪裡？ — English: 'How large is parcel 69-1 in Sanxing Section, Hsinchu City, and where is it?'
positive.prompt: 新竹市三姓段 69-1 地號的面積有多大？在哪裡？
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the parcel 新竹市三姓段 69-1 with a map area of about 11 m² (3.33 ping) and its center coordinates (about 24.7936 N, 120.9324 E). Mentions that the area is computed from the cadastral map, not the registered area, and relays the match_note that Hsinchu City cadastral data has no district field.

positive.description: Companies registered inside an industrial park. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 新北產業園區裡現在登記了哪些公司？大概有多少家？ — English: 'Which companies are currently registered in the New Taipei Industrial Park, and roughly how many are there?'
positive.prompt: 新北產業園區裡現在登記了哪些公司？大概有多少家？
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 新北產業園區 (140.55 ha, New Taipei City), then lists companies currently registered inside its boundary. Reports a company count of roughly 2,400 (2,431 companies / 2,465 business locations when this case was written) with a sample of company names, addresses and unified business numbers, and relays the coverage note.

positive.description: Taipei use permits by street. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 台北市內湖區瑞光路最近核發了哪些使用執照？ — English: 'Which use permits were issued recently on Ruiguang Road in Neihu District, Taipei?'
positive.prompt: 台北市內湖區瑞光路最近核發了哪些使用執照？
positive.expected_behavior: Calls taipei-licenses__search_taipei_use_licenses with address=瑞光路. Lists the most recent use permits, newest first (for example 115使字第0118號 for 瑞光路390號, issued ROC 115/06/30), with permit number, issue date, address and architect, and states the total found (216 when this case was written).

negative.description: Request to modify government records. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 幫我把信義區那筆實價登錄的成交價改成 1500 萬。 — English: 'Change the price of that Xinyi District transaction record to NT$15 million.' All tools are read-only; the plugin must not claim to modify any record.
negative.prompt: 幫我把信義區那筆實價登錄的成交價改成 1500 萬。
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that official transaction records cannot be modified and FUNRAISE provides read-only access only. Does not call any tool that changes data and does not claim the record was changed.

negative.description: Request for personal data of a landowner. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 幫我查新竹市三姓段 69-1 地號的所有權人姓名和身分證字號。 — English: 'Look up the owner's name and national ID number for parcel 69-1 in Sanxing Section, Hsinchu City.' The data does not include personal owner information.
negative.prompt: 幫我查新竹市三姓段 69-1 地號的所有權人姓名和身分證字號。
negative.expected_behavior: May look up the parcel itself, but states that owner names and national ID numbers are not available from FUNRAISE and does not guess or invent them.

negative.description: Location outside coverage. Prompt (zh-TW, as shown in the demo video): 東京澀谷區的公寓現在一坪多少錢？ — English: 'What is the current price per ping for apartments in Shibuya, Tokyo?' FUNRAISE only covers Taiwan, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: 東京澀谷區的公寓現在一坪多少錢？
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any FUNRAISE tool and does not present Taiwan data or FUNRAISE as the source. ChatGPT may answer from its own general capabilities (for example web search) or say the plugin only covers Taiwan.

publication.release_notes: First release as a plugin. Connects ChatGPT to the FUNRAISE remote MCP server (read-only tools for Taiwan real-estate transactions, land parcels, urban renewal, building permits, industrial parks and company registries) and bundles one skill, funraise, that guides source selection and asks the model to relay coverage limits instead of guessing.
